source.authors: Dutta S, Boruah B, Das A
source.title: New record of two natricine snakes, Hebius gilhodesi (Wall, 1925) and Herpetoreas davidi Nguyen et al., 2024 (Reptilia: Squamata: Colubridae), from India

eye: pupil as described for the new Indian material; side not stated
method: qualitative description of preserved museum specimens in the Description of new Indian material; Materials and methods (pieces joined): 'Morphological measurements and terminologies followed Das et al. (2021) as mentioned in the following: snout-vent length (SVL); [...] eye diameter (ED): horizontal diameter; eye to nostril distance (EN): anterior corner of eye to posterior edge of nostril; [...] interorbital distance (IO): measured at the anterior corner of orbit.' No pupil method is printed.
conditions: Not a type description: five Indian specimens of Hebius gilhodesi, described together in one paragraph (one species, one pupil value, no per-specimen pupil). Materials examined as returned by the page reader: WII-ADR1793 (adult male), WII-ADR1792 (adult female) and WII-ADR1800 (subadult female), Gandhigram, Changlang District, Arunachal Pradesh, India, 17-19 September 2022; WII-ADR3320 (adult male), Kamlang Tiger Reserve, Lohit District, 19 July 2023; WII-ADR3303 (juvenile female), Kamala Valley, Namdapha Tiger Reserve, Changlang District, 2 June 2023. The paper does not say whether the pupil was read on live or preserved animals or the constriction state. Anatomy only; vision not tested.
where: Results > Morphology > Hebius gilhodesi (Wall, 1925) > Description of new Indian material (Image 1); one long semicolon-separated sentence beginning 'Body subcylindrical'
quote: Body subcylindrical, widest at midbody, slightly tapering anteriorly and posteriorly; […] eye large with rounded pupil; orbit semi-circular, orbital diameter less than snout length; […]
note: new trait for the species: pupil_shape (same key as main). Not a repeat: grep of docs/ on main for Hebius gilhodesi and 10.11609/jott.10309.18.3.28479-28494 finds only eye_diameter_mm rows (desk-d490, desk-d497) and progress lines. Quote opens at the sentence start (the preceding sentence 'A moderate sized snake, SVL 370-410 mm in males and 250-370 mm in females.' ends with a full stop) and has two marked cuts; the sentence runs over 1,500 characters, so the middle is cut, and the kept clause is read in pieces of at most 100 characters and joined. A separate 'Colouration in life' sentence says 'pupil entirely dark with light outer margin' (colour, not filed). Reptile Database species page (reptile-database.reptarium.cz/Hebius/gilhodesi, reached from my own search 'Hebius gilhodesi new species Reptile Database') prints Hebius gilhodesi (WALL, 1925) with the comment that Bohra et al. 2025 revalidated gilhodesi (Wall himself synonymized it with khasiensis). Licence line on the PDF copyright block, read through the page reader as the sentence 'Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.' (the reader would not print the text before it or the JoTT sentence after it; the line appears in JoTT's standard copyright block). Search that reached the paper: Hebius gilhodesi new species Reptile Database.

source.authors: Dutta S, Boruah B, Das A
source.title: New record of two natricine snakes, Hebius gilhodesi (Wall, 1925) and Herpetoreas davidi Nguyen et al., 2024 (Reptilia: Squamata: Colubridae), from India

eye: pupil as described for the single new Indian specimen; side not stated
method: qualitative description of one preserved museum specimen in the Description of new Indian material; Materials and methods (pieces joined): 'Morphological measurements and terminologies followed Das et al. (2021) as mentioned in the following: snout-vent length (SVL); [...] eye diameter (ED): horizontal diameter; eye to nostril distance (EN): anterior corner of eye to posterior edge of nostril; [...] interorbital distance (IO): measured at the anterior corner of orbit.' No pupil method is printed.
conditions: Not a type description: one specimen, WII-ADR1051, adult female, Ngengpui Wildlife Sanctuary (22.48498 N, 92.75653 E; 215 m), Lawngtlai District, Mizoram, India, 7 September 2021, collected by Abhijit Das, Bitupan Boruah, Naitik G. Patel and Samuel Lalronunga (as returned by the page reader). The paper does not say whether the pupil was read on a live or preserved animal or the constriction state. Rests on one specimen. Anatomy only; vision not tested.
where: Results > Morphology > Herpetoreas davidi Nguyen et al., 2024 > Description of new Indian material; the sentence begins 'Head moderately distinct from neck'
quote: Head moderately distinct from neck and longer than broad (HW/HL = 0.4); […] eye large, with rounded pupil, orbit horizontally elliptical, eye diameter less than snout length (ED/SL= 0.5); […]
note: new trait for the species: pupil_shape (same key as main). Not a repeat: grep of docs/ on main for Herpetoreas davidi finds only the eye_diameter_mm row of desk-d490 and progress lines. Quote opens at the sentence start (after the full stop following '(TL/SVL = 0.2*)') and has two marked cuts; the kept clause is read in pieces of at most 100 characters and joined. Reptile Database species page (reptile-database.reptarium.cz/Herpetoreas/davidi, reached from my own search 'Herpetoreas davidi Reptile Database') prints Herpetoreas davidi NGUYEN, LALREMSANGA, BIAKZUALA & VOGEL, 2024, comment 'Distribution: see map in Nguyen et al. 2024: 176 (Fig. 7).' Licence line on the PDF copyright block, read through the page reader as the sentence 'Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.' (the reader would not print the text before it or the JoTT sentence after it; the line appears in JoTT's standard copyright block). Search that reached the paper: Hebius gilhodesi new species Reptile Database (then the same PDF).

source.authors: Idiiatullina SS, Pawangkhanant P, Suwannapoom C, Tawan T, Chanhome L, Nguyen TV, David P, Vogel G, Poyarkov NA
source.title: Another new species of karst-associated pitviper (Serpentes, Viperidae: Trimeresurus) from the Isthmus of Kra, Peninsular Thailand

eye: pupil of the holotype as described; side not stated
method: qualitative description of the holotype in the formal species description; Material and methods (page-reader pieces): 'Specimens were fixated in 4% buffered formalin for 24 h and later stored in 70% ethanol.'; eye measurements defined as 'ED = horizontal eye diameter' and 'VED = vertical eye diameter'; no pupil method is printed
conditions: One specimen: holotype AUP-02036, adult female. Type material as printed (pieces joined): 'Holotype THAILAND • ♀ adult; Chumphon Province, Muang District, Banna Subdistrict, Wat [= Temple] Tham Sanook and its cave Tham Sanook; 10.48089° N, 99.07323° E; 65 m a.s.l.; 27 Jul. 2022; P. Pawangkhanant, N.A. Poyarkov and C. Suwannapoom leg.; AUP-02036.' 'Paratypes THAILAND • 1 ♂ adult; same collection data as for holotype; 27 Jul. 2022; ZMMU Re-17664 (field label NAP-11581) • 1 ♀ adult; same collection data as for holotype; 27 Jul. 2022; ZMMU Re-17666 (field label NAP-11582) • 1 ♀ subadult; same collection data as for holotype; 15 Jan. 2023; P. Pawangkhanant and S.S. Idiiatullina leg.; ZMMU Re-17665 (field label ISS-004).' The pupil is described in the holotype description only; the paper does not say whether it was read on the live or the preserved animal or the constriction state. Rests on one specimen. Anatomy only; vision not tested.
where: Taxonomy > Taxonomic account > Genus Trimeresurus Lacépède, 1804 > Trimeresurus kraensis sp. nov. > Description (holotype)
quote: Pupil vertically elliptical, loreal pit present, and triangular in shape […].
note: new trait: pupil_shape (same key as main). Not a repeat: grep of docs/ on main for Trimeresurus kraensis and 10.5852/ejt.2024.930.2489 finds only eye_diameter_mm rows (desk-d617) and progress lines. Quote is the whole sentence with its trailing figure reference '(Fig. 3D)' cut and marked. Reptile Database species page (reptile-database.reptarium.cz/Trimeresurus/kraensis, reached from my own search 'Trimeresurus kraensis new species Isthmus of Kra European Journal of Taxonomy Reptile Database') prints Trimeresurus kraensis IDIIATULLINA, PAWANGKHANANT, SUWANNAPOOM, TAWAN, CHANHOME, NGUYEN, DAVID, VOGEL & POYARKOV, 2024, comment 'Distribution: see map in Pawangkhanant et al. 2025: 2 (Fig 1)'. Licence sentence read through the page reader on the PDF: 'This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0).' Byline as printed: Sabira S. IDIIATULLINA, Parinya PAWANGKHANANT, Chatmongkon SUWANNAPOOM, Tanapong TAWAN, Lawan CHANHOME, Tan Van NGUYEN, Patrick DAVID, Gernot VOGEL & Nikolay A. POYARKOV. Search that reached the paper: Trimeresurus kraensis new species Isthmus of Kra European Journal of Taxonomy Reptile Database.

source.authors: Xu Y-H, Wang S, Ma S, Burbrink FT, Peng L-F, Huang S
source.title: First report of albinism for Achalinus sheni (Serpentes, Xenodermidae), with extended diagnosis of the species

eye: pupil as described for three newly collected females; side not stated
method: qualitative description of preserved females in the Expanded description of the females; Materials and methods (page-reader pieces): 'Specimens were humanely euthanized using lethal injection with 0.7% tricaine methanesulfonate (MS222) solution [...] Then the specimens were directly preserved in 75% ethanol'; 'All other measurements were performed using Deli digital calipers (DL312200) to the nearest 0.1 mm'; eye diameter (ED) defined as taken from the most anterior corner of the eye to the most posterior corner; no pupil method is printed
conditions: Three females described together in one sentence: 'Based on three newly collected female specimens (field number: LFR2023008, LFR2023010, LFR2024015), an expanded description of the females is provided as below.' One of the three, LFR2024015, is the albinistic specimen (the specimens-examined list reads: three typical specimens LFR2023008 (adult female), LFR2023009 (adult male), LFR2023010 (adult female), and one albinistic specimen LFR2024015 (adult female), collected in July 2023 from Yangshi Town, Lianyuan City, Loudi City, Hunan Province, 370 m a.s.l., by Shu Li and Ziyuan Feng; page-reader pieces joined). So the pupil shape is stated once for a group that includes the albinistic female, and the paper does not give it per specimen. The same paper says for the albinistic specimen only 'The iris was blood-red, with a reddish pupil.' (colour, not filed). Wild-collected animals euthanized for preservation. Anatomy only; vision not tested.
where: Taxonomic account > Achalinus sheni Ma, Xu, Qi, Wang, Tang, Huang & Jiang, 2023 > Expanded description of the females > Measurements and scalation; one long semicolon-separated sentence beginning 'Tail relatively short'
quote: Tail relatively short, TAL […]/TL […] ratio 0.149–0.164; […] eye small, pupil round, ED […] 1.1 mm; […].
note: new trait: pupil_shape (same key as main). Not a repeat: grep of docs/ on main for Achalinus sheni and 10.3897/zookeys.1209.128944 finds only eye_diameter_mm rows (desk-d595) and progress lines. The quote is the sentence start plus the pupil clause with three marked cuts; the page reader inserts abbreviation expansions after TAL, TL and ED (tooltip markup), which are left out and marked. The sentence runs about 1,000 characters and was read in pieces of at most 100 characters and joined. Reptile Database species page (reptile-database.reptarium.cz/Achalinus/sheni, reached from my own search 'Achalinus sheni new species ZooKeys Reptile Database') prints Achalinus sheni MA, XU, QI, WANG, TANG, HUANG & JIANG, 2023; its Comment field is blank. Licence sentence read on the Pensoft preview (pieces joined): 'This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0), which permits unrestricted use, distribution, and reproduction in any medium, provided the original author and source are credited.' Byline as printed: Yu-Hao Xu, Shuai Wang, Shun Ma, Frank T. Burbrink, Li-Fang Peng, Song Huang. Search that reached the paper: "First report of albinism for Achalinus sheni" zookeys.pensoft.net.
